text: The language of Osprey-5 is Swift, which new contributors must know. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Avocet-2, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Shrike-9 is Oren Zielinski. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Shrike-9 applies to Avocet-2, the pager rotation differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Questions about Avocet-2 start with its owner, the Lattice team; they triage anything filed against it.
Kenji Halvorsen is on the pager rotation of Avocet-2 this month, with a deputy as backup.
Unlike Osprey-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Heron-9 is Haskell. Nobody should assume the language of Heron-9 applies to Osprey-5, the language differs.
Unlike Osprey-5, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Swift-5 is the Prism team. Nobody should assume the owner of Swift-5 applies to Osprey-5, the owner differs.
Questions about Merlin-2 start with its owner, the Keystone team; they triage anything filed against it.

Unlike Heron-9, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Merlin-2 is $725k. Nobody should assume the budget of Merlin-2 applies to Heron-9, the budget differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
The service Shrike-9 takes traffic on port 9910, and the port is fixed across every environment. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Avocet-2 listens on port 6831; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
The pager rotation for Osprey-5 is run by Elena Jaramillo; alerts page them first. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Shrike-9 runs in the Quito datacenter, next to its database. An older draft of this note was archived.
Unlike Merlin-2, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Swift-5 is the Osaka datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Swift-5 applies to Merlin-2, the datacenter differs.

Unlike Shrike-9, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Heron-9 is $280k. Nobody should assume the budget of Heron-9 applies to Shrike-9, the budget differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
The language of Swift-5 is Kotlin, which new contributors must know. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Osprey-5, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Heron-9 is 900 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Heron-9 applies to Osprey-5, the rate limit differs.
Unlike Avocet-2, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Heron-9 is 6104. Nobody should assume the port of Heron-9 applies to Avocet-2, the port differs.
The service Osprey-5 takes traffic on port 7921, and the port is fixed across every environment.
Merlin-2 reaches its retirement date on February 27, 2028, so every consumer has to migrate before then.

Unlike Merlin-2, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Avocet-2 is September 16, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Avocet-2 applies to Merlin-2, the retirement date differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
The rate limit of Osprey-5 is 3100 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Heron-9, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Shrike-9 is $3095k. Nobody should assume the budget of Shrike-9 applies to Heron-9, the budget differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Heron-9 reaches its retirement date on September 3, 2027, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
Questions about Shrike-9 start with its owner, the Lattice team; they triage anything filed against it. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Unlike Shrike-9, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Merlin-2 is the Lisbon datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Merlin-2 applies to Shrike-9, the datacenter differs.
Merlin-2 is implemented in OCaml; the language was chosen for its tooling.
The owner of Osprey-5 is the Harbor team, and every change to Osprey-5 goes through their review. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
The pager rotation for Swift-5 is run by Dmitri Thorne; alerts page them first.
Unlike Swift-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Avocet-2 is Erlang. Nobody should assume the language of Avocet-2 applies to Swift-5, the language differs.
Unlike Shrike-9, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Swift-5 is 6919. Nobody should assume the port of Swift-5 applies to Shrike-9, the port differs.
